sources.findings: The 201-entry location-policy map has neither FLK nor SGS; the global fallback crosswalk maps neither and lists both reference territories as unmatched. South America assessment records one location for each, no policy or policy metadata receipt, FLK unspecified source role and SGS named territory. Existing Europe overlay contains only ITA/ESP/XKX. Selected current entries are not transferred across ADM tiers.
